payingUser: A licensed amateur radio operator who logs contacts on a phone at a field site, a park activation, or a contest station and has to hand that log to another program afterwards.
paidUnit: A one-time unlock of unlimited contact logging plus working ADIF 3.1.4 import and export, offline, with no account and no cloud sync.
momentOfPayment: After the operator has logged the first ten contacts for free and taps Export, which opens the unlock sheet instead of a file picker.
distinctnessSentence: It writes an ADIF file that other logging programs actually import and it never asks for an account, where the measured 10K+ incumbent is ad-supported and its export complaint is answered with silence.
day1RevenuePath: A free tier that logs ten contacts, then a one-time in-app unlock of export and unlimited logging; the first dollar is the first export tap.
assumptionsUnverified: That amateur operators will pay a one-time fee instead of using the free HAMRS logger, which is rated 4.3 and already declares in-app purchases.
That ADIF interoperability is the purchase trigger, because the export complaint was two reviews of one 10K+ app rather than a measured pattern across the shelf.
That the shelf's 10K+ install ceiling is a market the factory can enter at all rather than its total size.
